description: This Java source file defines a Spring component that listens for authentication failure events related to bad credentials. When such an event occurs, it retrieves the user by email, increments the failed login attempts, and locks the user account if the maximum failed attempts threshold is reached.

classes.name: AuthenticationBadCredentialsListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens for bad credentials authentication failure events and updates user login attempt status accordingly.

methods.name: AuthenticationBadCredentialsListener
methods.description: Constructor that injects the UserService dependency.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the authentication failure event by updating user failed attempts and locking the account if necessary.
